headline: ARI @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.52 at TBR 4.94, with a projected total of 9.46. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: ARI moved +0.57 runs while TBR moved +0.93, changing the projected margin by -0.35 runs. The projected total climbed +1.50, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Nick Martinez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Ketel Marte, Jonathan Aranda, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorge Barrosa, Hunter Feduccia because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
